description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Kratos Defense and Security Solutions builds high-performance hardware for ground systems and space communications. The Manufacturing Software Engineer will develop, test, and deploy software that controls specialized equipment, automates testing, and enhances electronics manufacturing capabilities while collaborating with manufacturing users and cross-functional Agile teams.
Manufacturing software engineer developing, deploying, and troubleshooting automated equipment test-control applications

Responsibilities:
• Write software that controls specialized equipment to execute an automated test
• Test and deploy code for use on the onsite manufacturing floor
• Work directly in-person with users and stakeholders to iterate your designs
• A mix of green-field development and working in existing codebases
• Investigate faults methodically in order to resolve them in software or hand them off to a hardware expert
• Work on a cross-functional Agile team
• Receive mentorship and training from senior engineers and help non-coders with software problems
• A successful employee will work with a small team to develop and deploy one or two new software applications to the manufacturing floor in the first six months of employment

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
• Proficiency with theory and application of Data Structures and Algorithms
• Proficiency in git
• Proficiency writing code for medium to large projects without AI assistance (We use AI tools for some but not all projects)
• Familiarity with at least one command line interface such as Bash or Powershell
• Desire to learn electrical and systems engineering concepts on the job
• US Citizen with Secret clearance eligibility

Preferred:
• Proficiency with python
• Familiarity with full-stack webapp development. Our tech stack is postgres, sqlalchemy, flask, bootstrap, ES6 Javascript, and HTML
• Knowledge of computer networking concepts
• Any experience with computer hardware, robotics, or IT – even if you've just built a PC
• Experience with any of these technologies: REST APIs, RS-232, Arduino, 10+ Gbit Ethernet
• Experience with RF Test and Measurement
• Lacking RF T&M experience, advanced physics courses or music theory are relevant
• Experience with manufacturing or automated test
